e563c6ff-9f0f-47d5-b9d8-a9f061af9dfa.description: Next-gen cloud drone dispatch platform for medical emergency kits in remote areas with real-time waypoint routing.
e563c6ff-9f0f-47d5-b9d8-a9f061af9dfa.requirements:
1. Dynamic LiDAR avoidance & GPS flight routing
2. Real-time telemetry WebSocket gateway
3. Emergency override dashboard
4. FAA compliance flight logging

summary.what_it_is: A high-concurrency cloud-based autonomous drone dispatch platform tailored for rapid delivery of medical emergency kits to remote areas.
summary.problem_solved: Eliminates delay in delivering critical medical supplies to unreachable or terrain-blocked emergency zones by orchestrating real-time safe flight paths and emergency interventions.
summary.what_needs_to_be_built: Dynamic LiDAR/GPS pathing engine, real-time WebSocket telemetry gateway, emergency manual override Web UI, and an immutable FAA flight compliance log system.

must_have.name: Dynamic LiDAR Avoidance & GPS Routing Engine
must_have.description: Calculates real-time 3D flight paths incorporating dynamic LiDAR sensor feedback for obstacle avoidance and spatial trajectory updates.
must_have.rationale: Prevents collisions and adapts flight paths to unpredictable terrain and physical obstacles.

must_have.name: Real-time Telemetry WebSocket Gateway
must_have.description: High-throughput bi-directional streaming interface that ingests live drone telemetry data (battery, coordinates, airspeed, pitch/yaw) with sub-100ms latency.
must_have.rationale: Critical for constant monitoring and immediate response during medical delivery missions.

must_have.name: Emergency Override Dashboard
must_have.description: Operator intervention web interface enabling instant manual return-to-base (RTB), loiter, or forced landing commands.
must_have.rationale: Required safety protocol to prevent loss of equipment or ground safety incidents during airspace contingencies.

must_have.name: FAA Compliance Flight Logging
must_have.description: Auditable, tamper-evident log store recording all mission trajectories, telemetry histories, and pilot overrides to comply with FAA Part 135/107 regulations.
must_have.rationale: Mandatory regulatory prerequisite for legal drone delivery operations.

optional.name: Automated Battery Swapping Terminal Sync
optional.description: Automated status reporting and operational sync with ground battery swap stations.
optional.rationale: Enhances turnaround times for continuous mission dispatching.

optional.name: Predictive Weather Impact Modeling
optional.description: ML-driven micro-climate wind and weather forecast integration to adjust estimated arrival times and power reserve targets.
optional.rationale: Improves path reliability under extreme weather conditions.

items: OAuth2 / OIDC with mTLS for drone-to-cloud security
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for mission control pilots
must_need_requirements.rationale: Prevents unauthorized control hijack and ensures strict operator access boundaries.

items: TimescaleDB for high-rate telemetry time-series storage
must_need_requirements.rationale: Enables fast geospatial queries, time-series telemetry analysis, and ultra-low latency status sync.

items: WebSocket Gateway for live telemetry streaming
gRPC for internal low-latency service-to-service RPC
must_need_requirements.rationale: Supports low latency streaming and microservice communication essential for flight control.

items: Real-time LiDAR point-cloud clustering & dynamic local path recalculation algorithms
must_need_requirements.rationale: Provides rapid autonomous dynamic trajectory adjustments around stationary and moving obstacles.

items: Event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka or NATS
must_need_requirements.rationale: Guarantees low latency, high throughput, and fault-tolerant message handling.

items: Mapbox GL JS / Deck.gl 3D Geospatial UI
Next.js Dashboard with low-latency canvas graphics
must_need_requirements.rationale: Delivers fluid 60fps real-time 3D telemetry and flight track visualization for human operators.

items: Edge computing instances for fast regional telemetry processing
must_need_requirements.rationale: Ensures zero-downtime reliability, automated deployment, and scalable regional latency.

roles.rationale: Build 3D real-time Mapbox dashboard and emergency controls UI.
Build high-concurrency WebSocket telemetry gateway and event streaming services.
Develop dynamic 3D LiDAR point-cloud processing and GPS re-routing algorithms.
Setup Kubernetes, event message broker, CI/CD, and low-latency edge nodes.
Verify safety fail-safes, conduct simulation tests, and ensure FAA compliance logging.

Sub-hundred millisecond streaming pipelines and microservice communication.

risk_analysis.reason: Remote areas experience unstable cellular/satellite communication, leading to dropped WebSocket connections.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Implement client-side fallback autonomy on the drone hardware (fail-safe loiter/RTB) and auto-reconnecting buffer streams on the gateway.

risk_analysis.risk: Resource Overload Due to Small Team Size
risk_analysis.reason: 5 employees managing complex spatial AI, real-time networking, and compliance logs in 40 days could cause burnout and severe QA oversights.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Use off-the-shelf simulator tools (AirSim / Gazebo) and open-source spatial routing modules instead of building custom ML frameworks from scratch.

risk_analysis.reason: Missing required telemetry fields in flight logs could fail FAA approval.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Incorporate standardized FAA Part 135 data schema validation directly into the logging database layer from Day 1.

feasibility.key_verdict: The project target of 40 days is aggressively tight for 5 personnel due to the dual demands of real-time spatial AI and strict safety-critical overrides. However, it is feasible provided core AI components rely on existing libraries and optional features are strictly postponed.

ai_recommendation.primary_advice: Focus strictly on core core delivery dispatch functionality by leveraging existing geospatial processing libraries and drone simulation frameworks rather than building custom spatial engines.
actionable_steps: Use pre-built Gazebo/PX4 software-in-the-loop (SITL) simulators for drone telemetry testing.
Postpone battery swapping terminal sync and weather prediction modeling to Phase 2.
Contract or assign a dedicated DevOps/QA resource to prevent engineering bottlenecks in CI/CD and compliance validation.

02f0414a-e6ed-477e-85a0-45ec13f9d7ae.name: AegisHealth AI Diagnostic Clinical Suite
02f0414a-e6ed-477e-85a0-45ec13f9d7ae.description: Enterprise HIPAA-compliant clinical oncology AI platform with automated DICOM radiograph image analysis, differential diagnosis suggestions, and FHIR electronic health record integration.
02f0414a-e6ed-477e-85a0-45ec13f9d7ae.requirements:
1. DICOM medical image viewer with WebGL GPU-accelerated rendering and automatic lesion contour segmentation.
2. FHIR / HL7 standard interoperability pipeline to ingest hospital EHR medical histories securely.
3. Multi-modal generative AI clinical report summarizer with citation validation against medical literature.
4. Role-based access control (RBAC), multi-factor authentication, and immutable HIPAA audit logging.
5. Real-time radiologist collaborative review room with live annotations and speech-to-text dictation.
6. Asynchronous batch worker queue for heavy image inference processing with auto-scaling GPU workers.
7. Automated QA validation test suite and disaster recovery cloud replication on AWS / GCP.

summary.what_it_is: An enterprise-grade, HIPAA-compliant clinical oncology AI suite that provides automated DICOM radiograph image analysis, automated lesion segmentation, FHIR EHR data integration, multi-modal generative clinical report summarization, and real-time radiologist collaboration.
summary.problem_solved: Eliminates diagnostic bottlenecks, radiologist burnout, manual documentation overhead, and fragmented patient records by providing AI-assisted lesion segmentation, immediate literature-backed differential diagnoses, and unified FHIR patient history.
summary.what_needs_to_be_built: WebGL GPU DICOM image viewer, automated segmentation ML service, secure FHIR ingestion pipeline, multi-modal LLM summarizer with citation checker, WebSockets real-time review room with speech-to-text dictation, auto-scaling GPU batch worker queue, and HIPAA audit/DR infrastructure.

must_have.name: FHIR / HL7 Ingestion Pipeline
must_have.description: Secure interoperability engine connecting to enterprise EHRs to retrieve historical clinical records and lab results.

must_have.name: Multi-modal Generative AI Report Summarizer
must_have.description: LLM agent summarizing visual findings and EHR history into clinical notes with validated medical literature citations.

must_have.description: Role-based access control, multi-factor authentication, and tamper-proof ledger logging for all PHI accesses.
must_have.rationale: Non-negotiable regulatory requirement for enterprise deployment in healthcare environments.

must_have.name: Real-Time Collaborative Review Room
must_have.description: Live multi-user review room featuring synchronous pointer/annotation syncing and integrated speech-to-text dictation.
must_have.rationale: Enables multi-disciplinary tumor boards and peer consultations to review cases remotely in real time.

must_have.name: Auto-scaling GPU Batch Worker Queue
must_have.description: Asynchronous job worker pipeline for heavy model inference on large batch DICOM uploads.
must_have.rationale: Prevents web application timeouts during computation-heavy 3D/2D image processing.

employee_analysis.analysis_summary: Building a HIPAA-compliant multi-modal AI clinical suite in 60 days requires 8 specialized roles. With only 6 employees available, the team faces a shortfall in AI domain expertise and dedicated QA/DevOps coverage, increasing project risk.

End-to-end integration connecting DICOM viewer, FHIR metadata, AI models, and collaboration room.

risk_analysis.reason: 6 team members must complete 8 roles' worth of complex domain tasks in a aggressive 60-day window.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Use open-source pre-built libraries (e.g. OHIF/Cornerstone.js) and managed cloud services (AWS HealthLake) to reduce build load.

risk_analysis.risk: HIPAA Compliance Failure or Data Leakage
risk_analysis.reason: Improper encryption or unlogged PHI access can lead to severe regulatory penalties and platform shutdown.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Enforce strict automated IaC security blueprints, zero-trust network policies, and end-to-end KMS envelope encryption.

risk_analysis.risk: AI Model Hallucination in Citation Engine
risk_analysis.reason: Generative AI summarizers might fabricate clinical citations or diagnostic recommendations.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Implement a deterministic RAG validation step verifying citations against PubMed/NCBI indexed databases before display.

risk_analysis.reason: Large 3D DICOM files may stall inference queues during peak usage.
risk_analysis.mitigation: Deploy auto-scaling AWS GPU worker groups with priority queues for urgent diagnostic cases.

feasibility.key_verdict: The project is feasible within 60 days only if the team leverages managed clinical cloud services and open-source medical viewing SDKs to compensate for a 2-employee capacity deficit.

ai_recommendation.primary_advice: Focus custom engineering exclusively on the unique AI segmentation and citation pipeline; offload standard DICOM web rendering and FHIR storage to mature open-source tools (Cornerstone/OHIF) and managed cloud infrastructure (AWS HealthLake).
actionable_steps: Adopt pre-built OHIF / Cornerstone.js view components instead of coding a WebGL DICOM renderer from scratch.
Use AWS HealthLake for out-of-the-box HIPAA-compliant FHIR storage and indexing.
Contract 2 temporary specialists (1 AI/ML Engineer, 1 DevOps Compliance Engineer) or extend timeline by 15 days.
Defer non-critical features like speech dictation or extra billing code generators to Post-MVP.

optional_features_to_drop: Speech-to-text dictation in collaborative review room
